Really Easy Chocolate Pudding

chocolate delight

    * 1 cup sugar
    * .5 cup cocoa
    * .25 cup all-purpose flour
    * pinch of salt
    * one 12 oz. can evaporated milk
    * 1 cup water
    * optional: flavored extract
